title: Embodied fly, stage 5: do the simulated movement changes under the transmitter-class knobs go in the direction published for real flies? A registered literature comparison (SIMULATED against published)
status: registered before any literature search for this stage
roadmap: report/ROADMAP_EMBODIED_FLY.md, stage 5: 'comparison with published fly pharmacology (feeding and grooming under GABA-A and GluCl drugs): the direction of each published behavioural change is reproduced, or the mismatch is reported'
seen_before_registration: every stage-4a result: per condition the median proboscis extension under sugar and under sugar with bitter and the grooming reach depth (outputs/fly/embodied_stage4a_SIMULATED.json); e.g. partial GABA-A block raises extension under sugar with bitter, ACh block abolishes both movements

background knowledge before this search, not yet checked against sources: GABAergic interneurons are reported to restrain proboscis extension; picrotoxin blocks both RDL (GABA-A) and GluCl in insects; ivermectin activates GluCl
no literature has been searched for this stage

search_protocol.tool: web search (standard), then the abstract or full text of each candidate on its publisher, PubMed or PMC page
queries: Drosophila GABA antagonist feeding behavior proboscis extension
Drosophila GABAergic interneurons feeding restraint proboscis extension
Drosophila GABA grooming antennal grooming inhibition
Drosophila nicotinic antagonist feeding proboscis extension
Drosophila sodium channel blocker feeding behavior proboscis
search_protocol.candidates: every primary research article in the first page of results of each query
search_protocol.inclusion: adult Drosophila melanogaster; a manipulation that lowers or raises GABA-A (RDL) signalling, GluCl signalling, nicotinic acetylcholine signalling or neuronal excitability, either by a drug (pharmacological) or by genetic manipulation of the receptor (receptor-genetic) or of the transmitter's neurons (transmitter-neuron, reported separately); a measured change in proboscis extension to sugar (with or without bitter) or in front-leg / antennal grooming; the direction of the change stated in the abstract or results
search_protocol.exclusion: larvae; reviews without new data; measures other than proboscis extension or grooming (e.g. food intake by volume, locomotion), which are listed as out of scope; manipulations with no matching knob (e.g. GluCl activation by ivermectin), listed as impossible comparisons

mapping.GABA-A antagonist or RDL loss (picrotoxi: gaba_block (picrotoxin also maps to glucl_block, both compared)
mapping.proboscis extension to sugar: proboscis_sugar; to sugar with bitter: proboscis_sugar_bitter

simulated_direction: for the mapped family and movement, the sign of the change of the median from vehicle at the lowest dose of the family where |log2((x + 0.01) / (x_vehicle + 0.01))| >= 0.5 for that movement (stage 4a's line); 'none' if no dose reaches it
comparison: a published increase agrees with a simulated increase, a decrease with a decrease, no change with none; each (study, manipulation, measure) is one comparison; a study reporting several doses gives its overall reported direction

V1_the_pharmacology_agrees.statement: Most published directions under pharmacological and receptor-genetic manipulations are reproduced
V1_the_pharmacology_agrees.test: agreement in more than half of those comparisons; at least 3 comparisons needed, otherwise uninterpretable

V2_disinhibition_and_feeding_agree.statement: Where reduced GABA-A signalling is published to change proboscis extension, the simulation changes it in the same direction
V2_disinhibition_and_feeding_agree.test: every pharmacological or receptor-genetic gaba_block comparison on proboscis extension agrees; at least 1 needed, otherwise uninterpretable

reporting: Every included comparison (citation, DOI, manipulation, category, measure, published and simulated direction, agree or not), every excluded candidate with the reason, every impossible comparison; transmitter-neuron comparisons reported beside, not pooled; the search date.
not_claimed: that the model predicts any drug's effect: the knobs are transmitter-class scalings, the comparison is of directions only, and the literature found depends on the registered queries
